prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent illustrated navigation vignette for QuizzShow, a quiz-show venue in a cozy cartoon village game. This will be displayed as a tiny 32px menu illustration and as a larger section-heading vignette.
Primary request: create a very readable compact cluster of THREE objects: a chunky vintage golden microphone on a short stand to the left, a large warm apricot-orange quiz buzzer on a deep teal base at lower right, and one cream paper quiz card rising behind the buzzer bearing a single bold dark teal question mark "?". One small golden sparkle near the microphone.
Style: hand-inked storybook game prop illustration, bold slightly irregular almost-black outlines, flat cream, deep teal, warm golden yellow and apricot orange fills, restrained printed paper texture. Friendly, tactile, matching cream-stone/slate-roof Breton village cartoon artwork. Not photorealistic and not glossy 3D.
Composition: square, isolated object cluster, very tight balanced silhouette centered and using 90% of canvas, complete unclipped objects with a narrow transparent margin. Strong simple forms readable at 32px. No tiny lines, no busy decorations. The microphone capsule, orange buzzer and large question mark must each remain immediately recognizable.
Background: true alpha transparency. No backdrop, no tile, no badge boundary, no ground or cast shadow beyond the objects.
Text: only "?" on the paper card. No lettering, no logo, no watermark, no title. Deliver one image only.
processing: Sharp format conversion to 512×512 WebP, quality 90 and alphaQuality 100; generated alpha retained, all four corners transparent.
usage: QuizzShow menu entry on desktop and in the mobile drawer, matching section headings via KqPrintedArt kind school. Compact microphone, buzzer and question card readable at 32 px; accessible label remains HTML.
replaces: school-v3.webp remains archived as the building vignette; village map artwork remains active.
validation: Local browser review and targeted ESLint, details in output/quizzshow/menu-validation.json.
